prompt:
Use case: full character redraw for the next GameXXK party member, GUARD.
IMAGE1 is the current guard design, IMAGE2 is his original identity/prop reference, IMAGE3 is the project's gem-icon style authority, IMAGE4 is an approved cast member for clean graphic finish and compact standing presentation. Draw ONE GUARD ONLY. Never copy the woman, sword, gem shape, blue crystal material, magenta source background or framing from references.

IDENTITY:
A dependable strong ADULT Chinese male guard, broad square jaw, short dark chin beard and sideburns, thick simple brows, compact black topknot tied with one short ochre cloth band. Calm vigilant serious expression, not screaming or villainous. Warm tan face, simple dark cartoon eyes with at most one small highlight, eye/face/torso clearly front THREE-QUARTER SCREEN LEFT. Keep his masculine broad shoulders, thick but natural limbs and sturdy compact build, NOT obese or overly muscular anatomy display.
Approximately 3.5–4 actual head heights crown-to-sole EXCLUDING the topknot and spear tip, matching the project's compact cast while remaining the stocky defender.

COSTUME / GRAPHIC DIRECTION:
Original OCHRE-YELLOW sleeveless thick padded cloth guard vest over INDIGO-GRAY Chinese crossover shirt, dark brown loose trousers, ivory calf wraps and thick brown cloth/leather boots. Redesign the panel organization into clear stable rectangles and trapezoids: broad quiet ochre chest panels, one wide dark-brown horizontal waist sash with one simple iron rectangle buckle, two unequal large front skirt tabs. Sleeves have a few broad folds and plain cuffs. Keep one or two simple small square fastening plates only. No western plate armor, ornate pauldrons, helmet, cape or extra belts everywhere.
Silhouette built from broad shoulders, sturdy torso, round shield and two clear grounded legs. Clean strong horizontal/diagonal rhythm, no scattered tiny quilting squares or metal studs.

PROPS / ANATOMY:
Exactly ONE long straight WOODEN SPEAR held by the hand on screen-left. Continuous shaft extends in one unbroken straight line above and below the grip, one simple gray iron leaf-shaped spearhead with 2–3 broad planes and a short plain neck binding. Spear held nearly upright with slight lean, all tip and butt inside canvas. Correct opposing thumb and fingers around shaft; no bent, doubled or forked shaft.
Exactly ONE ROUND WOODEN SHIELD carried on the arm at screen-right, offset to the side so it does not cover the entire torso. Circular construction in three-quarter perspective, one central iron round boss, simple rim and 3–4 broad plank divisions. Do not change to square shield, do not add a big emblem, multiple boss jewels or intricate wood grain. Shield arm/strap connection should be plausible, hand may be partly concealed behind shield. There are two arms only.
Quiet protective standing posture, both complete boots planted and separated, one foot modestly forward and knees softly flexed. Upright sturdy ready stance, not deep squat, lunging, stepping, floating or stiff parallel mannequin legs. Head, chest, hips and knees point coherently to screen-left.

PROJECT GEM ICON PAINT:
Reference3's substantial large light/front/side planes and confident deep-ink outline translated to REAL cloth/wood/skin, not literal crystal. Clean coherent 2–3 dominant values per material, a few broad matte brush planes, low gloss, strong silhouette and quiet color areas. No hundreds of tiny triangular facets, gritty paper texture, fine hair/beard strands, dense woven detail, photoreal iris or noisy highlights. Face and hands remain organic, gently shaded with a single broad warm shadow.
Match the approved cast's restrained detail density and polished icon readability. Preserve ochre/indigo/brown/ivory palette, not reference3's blue.
One full-body guard centered in a square plain warm ivory background, all topknot/spear/shield/boots safely within about 7–8 percent margins. No text, label, frame, scene, ground shadow, additional characters or comparison layout.
purpose: First guard redraw using project identity, stable left-facing standing pose and clean gem-icon visual language.
visual_review: Square-jawed male guard with spear and round wooden shield, ochre/indigo palette, grounded stance and complete props retained; broad painted shapes and clear outline.
